_comment: EDIT THESE SCORES. They were set from what the public repos show, not from
anything Amisha said about herself, so treat them as a starting point rather
than a verdict. Nobody else can rate this for you.
Axes were chosen from the repos that exist: six on Docker and Compose, one
Jenkins pipeline, a Maven build, a Bash firewall manager, two Python projects.
Scores are out of 10 for the radar and out of 100 for languages. Keep language
notes under ~28 characters or the gauge legend clips them.

radar.why: Six repos: scaling, persistent storage, dependent startup, Spring Boot images
UFW Hybrid Manager — a CLI and TUI firewall tool written in Bash
jenkins-demo and a Maven build pipeline
Adaptive Care, a healthcare chatbot on Groq
Eight JavaScript repos, plus the CallIQ front end in Next.js
Stated direction rather than shipped work — raise it when that changes
